description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US: English

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can specify a custom value for this parameter, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance.

description.zh: 实例名称，不可传入空值。
description.en: The name of the instance. You cannot leave this parameter empty.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-instance-name --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0003 --instance-name test --region cn-hangzhou
